expectations.text: A single self-contained HTML deck with 6-8 slides is saved in outputs
All five key points from the request are covered
expectations.evidence: Burnout, competitors, pilot scope, CSAT and resolution time, and cost each have a slide

expectations.text: The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
expectations.evidence: Reply gives the slide order and assumptions to check; no design narration

expectations.text: Not every slide is a title plus bullet list (at least two distinct slide layouts)
expectations.evidence: Slides vary: big-number slide with comparison bars, statement slides; only 3 list items in the whole deck

expectations.text: Slide titles are takeaway sentences rather than topic labels
expectations.evidence: Titles are sentences, e.g. 'Two numbers decide it, and customers set both.'
